input.title: ci: add ai-review caller workflow
input.body: Wires the advisory AI reviewer onto PRs.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/review.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+name: review
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    branches: [main]
+jobs:
+  review:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      pull-requests: write
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: some-org/ai-review@main
+        with:
+          toolkit_ref: main
+        secrets:
          LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}
